svg.title: Configure Cline with the CPD OpenAI-compatible Qwen service
svg.desc: 1: Select OpenAI Compatible as the API provider. 2: Use the instructor-supplied CPD base URL and keep the API key masked. 3: Select the CPD Qwen model ID supplied for this course.
